```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(rstatix)
library(PMCMRplus) # Nemenyi検定用
library(knitr)

# パスの設定
base_path <- "C:/Users/lotta/OneDrive/Desktop/r-environment-for-researcher/projects/pt_job_hunting"
raw_file <- "C:/Users/lotta/OneDrive/Desktop/r-environment-for-researcher/回答生データ.xlsx"

# データの読み込みとクレンジング
raw_data <- read_excel(raw_file)

# 数字抽出用
extract_num <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  num <- str_extract(chartr("１２３４５６", "123456", x), "[1-6]")
  as.integer(num)
}

df_clean <- raw_data %>%
  filter(str_detect(.[[2]], "同意する")) %>%
  mutate(
    gender = .[[3]],
    sns_time = .[[5]],
    # 重要度(imp)
    imp_school = extract_num(.[[6]]),  imp_cl_prac = extract_num(.[[7]]),
    imp_friends = extract_num(.[[8]]), imp_hp = extract_num(.[[9]]),
    imp_site = extract_num(.[[10]]),   imp_event = extract_num(.[[11]]),
    imp_sns = extract_num(.[[12]]),
    # 利用頻度(use)
    use_school = extract_num(.[[13]]), use_cl_prac = extract_num(.[[14]]),
    use_friends = extract_num(.[[15]]),use_hp = extract_num(.[[16]]),
    use_site = extract_num(.[[17]]),   use_event = extract_num(.[[18]]),
    use_sns = extract_num(.[[19]])
  )
```

## 1. 対象者の属性情報
解析対象者（n = `r nrow(df_clean)`名）の属性情報です。

### 1.1 性別
```{r gender}
df_clean %>%
  count(gender) %>%
  mutate(割合 = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  kable(digits = 1, col.names = c("性別", "度数(n)", "割合(%)"))
```

### 1.2 SNS利用時間
```{r sns}
df_clean %>%
  count(sns_time) %>%
  mutate(割合 = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  kable(digits = 1, col.names = c("SNS利用時間", "度数(n)", "割合(%)"))
```

## 2. 主要アウトカム：各情報源の重要度
### 2.1 記述統計（中央値・IQR）
```{r imp_summary}
summary_imp <- df_clean %>%
  select(starts_with("imp_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "項目", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(項目) %>%
  summarise(
    Median = median(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1 = quantile(score, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
kable(summary_imp, caption = "重要度の中央値と四分位範囲")
```

### 2.2 統計検定（Friedman検定 & Nemenyi検定）
```{r imp_stat}
df_imp_long <- df_clean %>%
  select(starts_with("imp_")) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(id = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(-id, names_to = "source", values_to = "score")

# Friedman
res_f_imp <- friedman.test(score ~ source | id, data = df_imp_long)
print(res_f_imp)

# Nemenyi (有意差がある場合)
if(res_f_imp$p.value < 0.05) {
  cat("\n--- Nemenyi事後検定の結果 ---\n")
  res_n_imp <- frdAllPairsNemenyiTest(score ~ source | id, data = df_imp_long)
  print(res_n_imp)
}
```
